articles.title: BRICS women-led development summit - Prokerala
articles.full_text:
New Delhi: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MP Bansuri Swaraj addresses the BRICS WBA Women-Led Development Summit and Exhibition at The Lalit, in New Delhi on Wednesday, September 9, 2026.
Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MP Bansuri Swaraj during the BRICS WBA Women-Led Development Summit and Exhibition at The Lalit, in New Delhi on Wednesday, September 9, 2026.
Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MP Bansuri Swaraj being felicitated by Global Chairperson of the BRICS Women's Business Alliance Avarna Jain during the BRICS WBA Women-Led Development Summit and Exhibition at The Lalit, in New Delhi on Wednesday, September 9, 2026.
